name: Apex Solventless Live Rosin Tier 1 | Rainbow Belts 3.0 #4 (73-119u)
description:
This flavor is a 3rd generation remix of the classic Rainbow Belts strain, hunted in house by the Apex Solventless team! We hunted through many packs of seeds to find this winner! Our cut reeks of that delicious sour tropical perfume and is a delicious solventless treat that is packed with candy-lime-candy flavor!

Cross: Rainbow Belts 2.0 x Moonbow IX #113

Terp Profile: Citrus, Candy, Z
